tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The app's interactive accent: filled buttons, text-button labels, selected nav, links, focus ring, progress.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on a primary fill: the brand's reversed-out white.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Contained companion of the brand: the nav indicator, the fill a label sits on when raw indigo would miss AA.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text on the primary container.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary indigo, one step lighter than the brand.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Label on a secondary fill.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Fill behind a selected segment.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Label on a selected segment.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: The success tone as a scheme role.

tokens.name: on-tertiary
tokens.usage: Label on a success fill.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Filled status surface for success.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Text on the success container.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: The unreachable tone as a scheme role.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Label on an error fill: white measures 3.76:1 there, this ink 4.71:1.

tokens.name: error-container
tokens.usage: Filled status surface for error.

tokens.name: on-error-container
tokens.usage: Text on the error container.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Room Floor: the scaffold behind every screen.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Bright Label: primary text and icons on every surface and container.

tokens.name: surface-container-lowest
tokens.usage: Sub-floor: recessed wells such as log panels and code blocks.

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Riser: the first raised step above the floor; grouped-list backgrounds.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Panel: cards, bottom sheets, dialogs, KPI tiles, and the navigation bar.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Raised Panel: secondary panels and the ground accent chips most often sit on.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Instrument Face: input and chip fill, carrying on-surface-variant labels.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary Label: metadata, chip labels, input hints, unselected nav.

tokens.name: dim-text
tokens.usage: Dim Label: editorial captions and tertiary metadata on surface and surface-container. Below AA on surface-container-high; use the plate dim ink on plates.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Hairline: dividers, outlined buttons and cards, the rare boundary a tint cannot draw.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Grouped surfaces, genre chips, KPI tile border. The same byte as outline.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: The ink every elevation level paints its shadow in.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Modal barrier and hero scrims.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Snackbar fill.

tokens.name: on-inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Snackbar text on the inverse surface.

tokens.name: inverse-primary
tokens.usage: The brand on an inverse surface.

tokens.name: glass-surface
tokens.usage: Opacity of surface-container in the floating nav bar's glass fill. A tint, not a backdrop blur.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Pure white: reversed-out labels on the brand and on deep status fills.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Pure black: modal scrims, the dark theme's shadow ink and the glass shadow.

tokens.name: primary-dark
tokens.usage: Indigo Deep (indigo-600), fixed in both themes. The light theme's primary, and the dark theme's primary container.

tokens.name: primary-light
tokens.usage: Indigo Light (indigo-400), fixed. The dark theme's secondary and the light theme's inverse primary.

tokens.name: primary-lighter
tokens.usage: Indigo Pale (indigo-300), fixed. Text on the dark primary container; the light primary container.

tokens.name: seerr
tokens.usage: Seerr Indigo (indigo-500): the Seerr accent and the app's own brand colour, the dark theme's primary.

tokens.name: radarr
tokens.usage: Radarr Amber, the movies accent. A fill label on it takes ink-on-bright: white measures 2.15:1.

tokens.name: sonarr
tokens.usage: Sonarr Violet, the series accent; also the brand gradient's end.

tokens.name: lidarr
tokens.usage: Lidarr Pink, the music accent.

tokens.name: readarr
tokens.usage: Readarr Red, the books accent.

tokens.name: prowlarr
tokens.usage: Prowlarr Orange, the indexers accent.

tokens.name: bazarr
tokens.usage: Bazarr Sky, the subtitles accent.

tokens.name: qbittorrent
tokens.usage: qBittorrent Blue, the torrent client accent.

tokens.name: transmission
tokens.usage: Transmission Crimson: walked off the brand red so it clears readarr (ΔE 10.8) and the error tone (ΔE 8.8).

tokens.name: sabnzbd
tokens.usage: SABnzbd Gold, a usenet client accent.

tokens.name: nzbget
tokens.usage: NZBGet Green, a usenet client accent.

tokens.name: dockge
tokens.usage: Dockge Teal, the stacks accent.

tokens.name: truenas
tokens.usage: TrueNAS Blue, the storage accent.

tokens.name: unraid
tokens.usage: Unraid Orange, the server accent.

tokens.name: nginx-proxy-manager
tokens.usage: Nginx Proxy Manager Vermilion, the brand value unchanged: a red-orange clear of the amber band.

tokens.name: jellyfin
tokens.usage: Jellyfin Purple, a streaming accent.

tokens.name: plex
tokens.usage: Plex Bronze: deliberately not brand gold #E5A00D, which collides with sabnzbd and the fault tone.

tokens.name: nav-dashboard
tokens.usage: Dashboard tab pill: the app's own indigo.

tokens.name: nav-activity
tokens.usage: Section Cyan (cyan-500), the Activity tab pill. A section, not a service, and never a status hue.

tokens.name: nav-search
tokens.usage: Section Purple (purple-500), the Search tab pill.

tokens.name: nav-settings
tokens.usage: Section Teal (teal-500), the Settings tab pill.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: GREEN (green-500): available or complete. A fill byte; as text it always goes through the tone walk.

tokens.name: success-container
tokens.usage: Deep green (green-800): the dark success container, and text on the light one.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: AMBER (yellow-400): a fault, never the backlog. Deliberately not radarr's amber-500.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: BLUE (blue-500): queued or informational.

tokens.name: ink-on-bright
tokens.usage: gray-900: the label a bright fill takes where white loses the contrast measurement.

tokens.name: plate-surface
tokens.usage: Artwork stand-in (a missing poster, an album without cover). Fixed dark in both themes: artwork is not palette.

tokens.name: plate-well
tokens.usage: The letterboxed well behind a backdrop; fixed dark in both themes.

tokens.name: plate-outline
tokens.usage: Hairline on a plate; fixed.

tokens.name: plate-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on a plate.

tokens.name: plate-dim-ink
tokens.usage: Secondary text on a plate: 5.49:1 on the plate surface, 7.02:1 on the well.

families.mono: Menlo, "SF Mono", "Roboto Mono", "Droid Sans Mono", Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-large
styles.usage: Rare editorial and onboarding moments. The only roles allowed 800.

styles.name: display-medium
styles.usage: Editorial display, one step down.

styles.name: display-small
styles.usage: The smallest display.

styles.name: headline-large
styles.usage: Screen-level headings.

styles.name: headline-medium
styles.usage: Screen headings on compact widths.

styles.name: headline-small
styles.usage: Detail hero titles, collapsed.

styles.name: title-large
styles.usage: Section headers. The app-bar title is this role at 700.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: A service's own name in its app bar, one step under Title.

styles.name: panel-header
styles.usage: An h2 inside a page: a Dockge stack, an NPM host, a TrueNAS console section.

styles.name: title-medium
styles.usage: Card titles; KPI values, read at 700.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: The primary line of a row that is a name, not a sentence: a device, a session, a proxy host.

styles.name: title-small
styles.usage: Small titles and dense card headers.

styles.name: body-large
styles.usage: The widest prose measure: overviews and descriptions.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: Running text, metadata, empty-state copy, input text.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Fine print and secondary lines.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: The answer in a row: an attention item, a queue entry, a table cell. Never smaller than the label describing it.

styles.name: label-large
styles.usage: Button labels (at 600) and tab labels.

styles.name: label-medium
styles.usage: Chips, badges, nav labels.

styles.name: label-small
styles.usage: The 11px floor. Nothing in the app renders smaller.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above a section or a single-value readout. The one role whose tracking is authored; set the text uppercase.

styles.name: chrome
styles.usage: Dense desktop-shell chrome off the ramp. Its size is both the default and the enforced floor.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Inside components only: glyph-to-label gap, between two lines of a row.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Minimal spacing for tight layouts; chip vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Inside components only: chip inner padding, nav bar inner padding.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Small spacing for related elements; badge padding.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: Inside components only: row line gaps, inner plates.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Compact spacing: grid and carousel gaps, button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-ml
tokens.usage: Inside components only: nav pill horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: The default: page gutter, card padding, input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Section separation; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Major blocks.

tokens.name: space-xxxl
tokens.usage: The largest section break.

tokens.name: space-grid-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between grid items.

tokens.name: space-carousel-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between carousel items.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Sharp corners (full-bleed backdrops).

tokens.name: radius-hair
tokens.usage: Small-object geometry: a 3dp tag.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Subtle curves; progress tracks.

tokens.name: radius-xs2
tokens.usage: Small-object geometry: a poster corner in dense rails.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges and small objects.

tokens.name: radius-sm2
tokens.usage: Small-object geometry: an inner plate.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The default: cards, buttons, inputs, posters, snackbars, list tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom-sheet top corners, grouped settings.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Selected affordances only: the nav indicator and segment pills. Never a general corner.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The floating navigation bar.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Metadata pills (tags, genres, ratings). Never an interactive container.

shadow.note: Two-layer stacks (a tight contact shadow plus a wide ambient one), deeper on dark. Flat is the default; a surface earns a shadow only when it must read as lifted. Each layer's opacity is per theme.

tokens.name: level-1
tokens.usage: Resting cards, rows, KPI tiles.

tokens.name: level-2
tokens.usage: Posters, elevated cards, feature cards.

tokens.name: level-3
tokens.usage: Sheets, popovers, hero surfaces, a poster mid-flight.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: The floating navigation bar: a deep ambient shadow plus a 1px top highlight.

breakpoint.note: Window regimes, never a device check.

tokens.name: bp-nav-compact
tokens.usage: Below this width the floating bar switches to compact item targets.

tokens.name: bp-desktop-mobile
tokens.usage: Below this width a desktop window paints the touch shell under a bare drag strip.

tokens.name: bp-touch-rail
tokens.usage: At or above this width a touch build moves from the bottom bar to a side rail.

tokens.name: bp-desktop-compact
tokens.usage: Below this width the desktop shell uses its compact variants.

tokens.name: bp-content-well
tokens.usage: The widest the main content well may grow, on any shell.

tokens.name: bp-desktop-min-width
tokens.usage: Narrowest a desktop window may be dragged: a small phone's width.

tokens.name: bp-desktop-min-height
tokens.usage: Shortest a desktop window may be dragged: the compact artboard's height.
